name: University of Findlay
academic_ranking: Private university founded in 1882; ranked #359 (tied) of 436 national universities in the 2025 U.S. News & World Report rankings. Offers nearly 80 undergraduate programs, 11 master's, and 5 doctoral programs; accredited by the Higher Learning Commission. Notable for equestrian studies and the Mazza Museum.
financial_aid: Approximately 93% of Findlay students receive financial aid. Both merit-based (ACT/SAT-driven) and need-based (FAFSA) aid offered, plus federal/state grants and loans. FAFSA federal school code 003045. Financial aid contact: finaid@findlay.edu, (419) 434-4791.
facilities_notes: 76-acre main campus in Findlay, OH, plus five off-campus facilities. Specific softball facility details not confirmed from public pages checked 2026-07.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II program competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC) as the Findlay Oilers.
notes: Data gathered 2026-07 from findlayoilers.com softball coaches and roster pages and findlay.edu tuition/financial-aid pages. Tuition figure $40,698 reflects 2026-27 undergraduate rate ($908/credit hour). No Twitter/X handles listed for any softball staff. Scholarship count not publicly disclosed.
